# NOT OURS. Generated by the MigrationStation session (Wu'barrk's machine), 2026-09-07, and copied
# here verbatim because its own scratchpad does not outlive that session. Its work, not this mod's;
# do not edit in place -- replace it if MigrationStation regenerates it.
#
# WHAT IT IS: a Cecil METADATA comparison of assembly_valheim, 0.221.12 dedicated server against
# 0.221.13 dedicated server (Steam public-test build 23105022). Same-axis, server vs server: an
# earlier mixed-axis run (0.221.12 CLIENT vs 0.221.13 SERVER) was redone at this repo's request,
# and every row survived unchanged except one -- PlayFabAuthWithCustomID is a BUILD-KIND difference,
# not version movement. On the server axis 1.0 adds ChunkSaveMapping and SaveFileHelper and removes
# ZDOComparer.
#
# WHAT IT CANNOT SEE: signatures only -- visibility, static, return type, parameter types and names,
# and field signatures. It does NOT compare method BODIES. So it is silent about exactly the kind of
# difference docs/engine-sweeps/2026-09-07-baseline-client-vs-server.md found between the two
# 0.221.12 builds (ZNet.IsDedicated() compiled to `return false` client / `return true` server;
# Terminal.AddString logging on one and not the other). A companion 0.221.12 client-vs-server control
# run reported zero SIGNATURE differences across ZDOMan, ZNetScene, ZoneSystem, ZNetView, Character,
# RandEventSystem, ZDO, ZNet, World, Inventory and PieceTable -- which means no signature drift, NOT
# no drift.
#
# READ ALONGSIDE the two body-level checks this repo made against the same 0.221.13 server decompile
# (libs-Tools/DECOMPILED-PLAYTEST-build23105022/), which a signature diff structurally cannot make:
#   ZoneSystem.GetZone(Vector3)   arithmetic IDENTICAL, FloorToInt((v + 32.0) / 64.0) on both axes;
#                                 only the return type moved, Vector2i -> Vector2s.
#   ZDOMan.ReleaseNearbyZDOS      unchanged statement for statement -- the !Persistent skip,
#                                 activatedArea = m_activeArea - 1, the SetOwner(0L) strip and the
#                                 grant branch. Only the vector type moved.
# Both are why D5's fix and Core/ZoneOwnership.cs cross the version step untouched.
#
# THE CLIENT AXIS IS UNVERIFIED. No 1.0 client snapshot exists locally. Any client-side claim derived
# from this file is expectation, not evidence.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
